scope_forms_write_hint: Drafts only; a live form accepts only theme and color changes.
scope_forms_publish_hint: Can put a form online or take it offline. Not available together with reading responses.
scope_responses_read_hint: Off by default: contains personal data of respondents.
scope_shortlinks_write_hint: Cannot change or delete existing links.
scope_pages_write_hint: Drafts only; a live page accepts only theme and color changes.
scope_appointments_read_hint: Off by default: contains names and emails of the people who booked. Not available together with publishing.
scope_appointments_write_hint: Includes reading appointments, which contain personal data. Not available together with publishing.
scope_account_full_hint: Everything you can do in the dashboard with links, bio pages and forms, including deleting them and their responses, and reading responses. Replaces every other permission.
scope_pages_publish_hint: Can put a page online or take it offline. Not available together with reading responses.
unavailable_body: The request is not valid. Go back to the app and try again.
wants_access: wants to access your Kurz account
unverified: Unverified app. After you allow, it returns to
full_body: This app will be able to publish, edit and permanently delete your links, bio pages, forms and responses, and to read what people typed in your forms. Text typed by respondents is untrusted and could try to steer the AI. Only allow this for an app and a conversation you trust.
exclusive_title: Reading personal data and publishing are exclusive
exclusive_body: Text typed by respondents is untrusted. To keep it from steering what gets published, an app can read responses or publish, never both.
personal_body: Reading responses sends what people typed in your forms to the AI service behind this app. Only turn this on if you are allowed to share that data. Text typed by respondents is untrusted.
